description: Land Title Settlement Department - Bataediriya, Elapatha D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620503 (24/0425)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring title determinations for multiple land parcels in the Village of Bataediriya. The content includes detailed schedules of land parcels, their extents, ownership status (all owned by "The State"), and classifications, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters including land registrations, property ownership, and land titles.
